body: ADR ruling for bd-01M176GSTHHQQX744F5YPPDWW7 requested before I freeze the type shape. Current-source review (post-01M1795HH99NCP5XQRY17WCG7C) answers the two questions cleanly: NarrativeCompilation should be the durable output of this transformation and retain MentionGraph plus all ResolutionState outcomes; when enough structure exists it may wrap StoryModel[Draft] and StoryValidator.ValidationOutcome, but only the optional validated model can feed AlignmentSource. A partial run still publishes NarrativeCompilation; a successful vertical run publishes it plus StoryModel[Validated]. I recommend ACCEPT. Module stays document; acquire remains generic and story-independent. Please accept or amend this disposition; I will draft the ADR around it while waiting, without production API edits.
